summary.en: Deduplicate flip evidence and limit exile accounting to the current ballot.
summary.zh: 翻牌证据按发言人去重，放逐记账仅计当轮投票。

reason: Corrects shared evidence processing and documents the limits of old-save recovery.

compatibility.en: No new snapshot fields. Existing accumulated scores are preserved on restore, not retroactively recomputed; use a new game to evaluate corrected accounting throughout.
compatibility.zh: 不新增存档字段。恢复保留已有累计分，不追溯重算旧偏差；完整评估修复效果应新开一局。
